targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS total_contracts FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ','))))

SELECT coalesce(sum(v.preco_contratual),0) AS total_value FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ','))))

SELECT round(avg(v.preco_contratual),2) AS avg_value FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ','))))

SELECT count(DISTINCT v.adjudicante_id) AS distinct_adjudicantes FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ','))))

SELECT gs AS time, count(v.idcontrato) AS contracts FROM generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), interval '1 day') gs LEFT JOIN procurement.v_contracts_material v ON v.celebrated_at >= gs AND v.celebrated_at < gs + interval '1 day' AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs

SELECT date_trunc('month', v.celebrated_at) AS time, count(*) AS contracts FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', v.celebrated_at) AS time, coalesce(sum(v.preco_contratual),0) AS contract_value FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT v.adjudicante_name AS adjudicante, sum(v.preco_contratual) AS total_value FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) GROUP BY v.adjudicante_name ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 10
